name: Write an object
description: Create, update, upsert or delete an OpenRegister object for every item — as the person who started the run, with their permissions.

returned.label: Register
returned.help: The register the objects are written into.

returned.label: Schema
returned.help: The schema the objects are validated against. A slug is resolved within the chosen register only.

returned.label: Operation
returned.help: One of: create, update, upsert, delete. Update, upsert and delete need at least one match pair.

returned.label: Write object at path
returned.help: Write the object found at this path WHOLE, instead of listing properties in "fields". Use it when the properties are not known up front — a synchronization with no mapping, for example. Configure this or "fields", never both.

returned.label: Write the whole page in one call
returned.help: Create and upsert only. One bulk save covers every item — much faster for large pages, but per-object lifecycle events are not dispatched, and a bulk upsert must match on "uuid" alone with "replace" on.

returned.label: Skip an item when this field says so
returned.help: A field on the item. When it holds true, or the word "skip", that item passes through UNWRITTEN and still travels on to later steps. Use it to leave unchanged objects alone. Filtering those items out instead would remove them from what a synchronization sweep counts as reached, and the sweep would then delete them.

returned.label: Replace instead of patch
returned.help: An update normally patches only the fields named. Replacing writes the payload as the whole object — fields it does not name are gone.

returned.label: Field to store the written object in
returned.help: With a field name, the incoming item is preserved and the written object is added under it. Empty means the written object replaces the item.

returned.label: Record the written object as
returned.help: Your own word for what this object is to this flow, such as "case" or "besluit". A later step can then attach its task to it by that name. Leave it empty and the step records nothing.

returned.label: Write cap
returned.help: The most writes one step execution may perform. The instance default applies when empty.

returned.label: When a field value is missing
returned.help: "omit" (default) drops the field from the payload; "fail" fails the item.

returned.label: When a created identifier is taken
returned.help: "overwrite" (default) keeps the historical upsert behaviour; "fail" refuses, for writes that are claims — locks, slots, leases. Not available in bulk.

returned.label: When a delete matches nothing
returned.help: "error" (default) fails the item; "skip" passes it through with "deleted": false.

returned.label: Confirm deletion
returned.help: A delete step will not save without this deliberate second acknowledgement.

returned.label: Destroy instead of tombstone
returned.help: Deletes are soft by default, which is what makes a mistaken flow recoverable. Turn this on only for rows that are claims whose identifier must become claimable again.
